$description: One row of a `jx-table`: a CSS table row with the row role. It owns no look, because whether a row responds to a pointer, and how, is the consumer's to say.

rowindex.description: Which row of the WHOLE set this is, one-based and counting the header row, written as aria-rowindex. A table that draws only the rows in view gives every row its place, so a reader hears where the slice sits. Zero, the default, writes nothing.
